PR Summary by Qodo

Add session-aware room messaging, state leases, and preflight checks ✨ Enhancement 🧪 Tests 📝 Documentation 🕐 40+ Minutes
AI Description

>
>• Adds session-aware messaging, role guards, cursor handover, and automatic escalation
>  notifications.
>
Diagram

```mermaid graph TD CLI["room.py CLI"] --> MSG["Message commands"] --> ISSUE["GitHub issue"] CLI --> STATE["State worktree"] --> REMOTE[("State branch")] TPL["Playbook templates"] --> STATE CLI --> PRE["Preflight checks"] --> API["GitHub API"] ```
High-Level Assessment

>The following are alternative approaches to this PR:
1. Split state and messaging into modules
- ➕ Separates Git lease logic from issue messaging as the CLI grows. - ➕ Allows narrower tests and ownership boundaries. - ➖ Complicates the specified standalone, single-file distribution. - ➖ Adds packaging work without changing the v1 coordination model.
>**Recommendation:** Keep the single-file CLI for v1 because standalone distribution is an explicit constraint. Consider extracting state and lease logic if later milestones make the file materially harder to maintain. Review the documented M4 deferrals separately: hand-damaged machine blocks and stale worktree recovery remain known edge cases.

### The AI Code Review Platform

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
  - Concrete code fixes
  - Clear explanations
  - Prioritized feedback

- ## Security & Reliability Checks
  - Identifies risky patterns
  - Reduces attack surface area
